assertions.name: 离线Maven构建
assertions.actual: 多文件工程已离线编译并生成可执行JAR。

assertions.name: 列表
assertions.expected: 分页对象与5条初始数据
assertions.actual: HTTP 200 {"items":[{"id":1,"title":"Java文档","saved":false},{"id":2,"title":"SQL手册","saved":true},{"id":3,"title":"接口笔记","saved":false},{"id":4,"title":"开发指南","saved":true},{"id":5,"title":"数据库指南","saved":false}],"page":0,"size":10,"total":5}

assertions.name: 拒绝非法分页page=bad
assertions.actual: HTTP 400 {"message":"JSON或请求参数格式不正确"}

assertions.name: 写入前校验
assertions.actual: HTTP 400 {"message":"JSON或请求参数格式不正确"}

assertions.name: 运行与数据流说明
assertions.expected: RUN.md至少80字符，说明环境、命令和数据流
